Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Maharashtra · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/52/2011/021 
 Dated: March 31, 2026 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Road Widening - Maharashtra Pkg-21" (roads highways),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
 been completed in all respects on April 22, 2011 at a gross executed value of INR 19,32,99,999/-
 
 (Rupees 19.33 Crore Only). 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
 
 satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Neha Chopra. This certificate is issued for record
 
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-021 Page 1 of 1
